package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for shared_gorm_db_state_mutated_and_reused_across_requests: Code that mutates shared `*gorm.DB` state and reuses it as if it were immutable configuration.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

var sharedDB *gorm.DB

type Product struct {
	ID       int
	TenantID string
	Name     string
}

func GetProducts(tenantID string) ([]Product, error) {
	var products []Product
	err := sharedDB.Where("tenant_id = ?", tenantID).Find(&products).Error
	return products, err
}

func GetOrders(tenantID string) ([]Product, error) {
	var products []Product
	err := sharedDB.Where("tenant_id = ?", tenantID).Find(&products).Error
	return products, err
}
